claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_ability_score
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item permanently increases an existing ability score by a fixed amount, capped at a maximum, rather than setting or flooring it to a specific value while worn or attuned.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: your Charisma increases by 2, to a maximum of 30
